coordinateConvention: Canonical bike metres; asset-to-bike quaternion remains the immutable selected contract. Every digit is native-rest local quaternion right-multiplied by its exported local axis-angle. Never translate finger bones.

left.convention: Runtime resets exact native rest local quaternion, then right-multiplies axis-angle(axisLocal,maxRadians). Bone positions remain exact rest. Socket quaternion is world socket orientation, not wrist orientation.

controlDerivation.method: Actual native CMC-to-terminal-thumb shaft and index-MCP direction define the opposition plane; its transverse hinge is projected off each actual thumb shaft and expressed in its native rest local frame. No rest transform, source skin, mesh or digital translation is changed.
controlDerivation.anatomicalBasis: PMC3653006 Discussion describes thumb pronation approximately90degrees relative to palm; global palm-normal flex alone is not an independent thumb opposition-plane definition
controlDerivation.limits: Constructed anatomical control hypothesis; requires actual source pulp normal, contact, whole-surface and moving-parent review.

pulp.reason: No outward own-segment triangle on nominal shaft-center ray in declared thumb/index plane; no thenar/proximal pulp label is invented

finiteSurface.scope: Every selected glove triangle whose positive skin influences belong entirely to the same native wrist/palm/digit subtree; forearm cuff excluded and must be checked in full runtime arm pose
